# Getting Support

Thank you for your interest in the **Majelis Galilea** administrative platform.

This project serves as the institutional management portal, document generation engine, and meeting workflow system for GMAHK Galilea church officers.

---

## Technical Issues & Bug Reports

If you encountered a bug, UI regression, or script execution error:
1. Search existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/zvenians/majelis-galilea/issues) to ensure the issue is not already being tracked.
2. If new, open a structured report using the [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/zvenians/majelis-galilea/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
3. Include device specifications, browser version, reproduction steps, and error logs if available.

---

## Feature Requests & Workflow Proposals

Proposals for administrative efficiency and board document workflows are welcome:
1. Submit an issue using the [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/zvenians/majelis-galilea/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).
2. Detail the administrative use case and how it impacts board officers or secretarial processes.

---

## Security Inquiries

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities, authentication concerns, or token exposures publicly:
* Review our [Security Policy](https://github.com/zvenians/majelis-galilea/security/policy).
* Submit vulnerability reports privately to **simatupangkevin9@gmail.com**.

---

## Official Church Operations

For official church administrative access, Google Apps Script deployment credentials, or board agenda coordination:
* Visit the production portal: [majelis-galilea.vercel.app](https://majelis-galilea.vercel.app)
* Contact the church secretariat through official congregational channels.
